tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250mkha' 'gro'i smre bshags bzhugs so// 1$0000300oṃ/ ye shes mkha' 'gro dbang phyug khro rgyal gtso// bde chen gnyis med yum gyi dbyings su sbyor// bdag tu lta ba'i nga rgyal 'joms mdzad pa'i// dpang gyur rdo rje dam can dgongs su gsol// ta na'i gnas mchog sgrol ba gnas ma bstabs// ga ṇa'i gnas mchog sbyor ba byin ma brlabs// dpal chen khro rgyal thugs dang ci 'gal ba// thugs rje che mnga' khyed la bzod par gsol// rmad du byung ba'i mchod pa tan gaṇa ni// ye shes lnga yi 'od zer rnam par 'phro// dbang po drug gi longs spyod mkho dgur ldan// 'dod pa lnga yi yon tan bsam yas kyis// ye shes mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskang gyur cig /dpal chen khro rgyal yab yum thugs rje yis// rtse gcig sgrub pa po yi grogs mdzod la// bar gcod byed pa'i dgra bgegs rdul du rlogs// bsgrubs pa'i 'bras bu dus 'dir bstsal du gsol// hūm̐/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro dbang phyug gau rī brgyad// siṃ ha la sogs yul gyi phra men brgyad// rta gdong la sogs 'bar ma khro mo bzhi// dpang gyur rdo rje dam can dgongs su gsol// oṃ/ sgom sgrub dus las g.yel bar gyur pa yis// sgrub pa'i rdzas mchog bdud rtsi a mṛta// dus drug mchod pa'i tshul du ma sbyar ba// bzod par gsol lo tshangs par bstsal du gsol// byang chub sems dang māṃ sa rak+ta dang*// dri chen dri chu go ku da ha na// gnyis med sbyar ba'i sman mchog a mṛta// sha khrag dmar gyi mchod pa chen po 'dis// rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskang gyur cig /'bar ba'i sku mchog rdzogs pa'i dkyil 'khor 'dir// bdud dang srin po ma lus 'dul ba'i phyir// rtse gcig sgrub pa po la zhal ston la// bar chad byed pa'i dgra bgegs rdul du rlogs// oṃ/ sha za mkha' 'gro dbang phyug nyi shu brgyad// srid gsum rgyal mo dur khrod brgyad kyi yum// gtso mo mngon spyod ma bdun 'khor dang bcas// dpang gyur rdo rje dam can dgongs su gsol// mchod pa lo zla'i dus las 'das pa dang*// rdzas dang phyag rgya dus 'dir ma rdzogs shing*// sha khrag dmar gyi dam las g.yel gyur pas// sha za mkha' 'gro'i thugs dang ci 'gal ba// bzod par gsol lo tshangs par bstsal du gsol// dur khrod rdzas mchog thal chen ba su ta// sha khrag dmar gyi mchod pa rab sbyar te// bhan+dha'i snod du dmar chen bskyil pa 'dis// sha za mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskang gyur cig

/oṃ/ sngon tshe dpal chen khro rgyal spyan snga ru// sus kyang ma bcol nyid kyis zhal 'ches te// rtse gcig sgrub pa po yi grogs mdzod la// rnal 'byor dbang phyug chen po'i 'khor srungs shig /oṃ/ las kyi mkha' 'gro phyi yi rnal 'byor bzhi// bdag nyid chen mo la sogs ma mo'i tshogs// lha dang lha min phyogs bcu'i mkha' 'gro ma// dpang gyur rdo rje dam can dgongs su gsol// lta ba mthos pas spyod lam rtsing ba dang*// nya stong gso sbyong dus las g.yel gyur cing*// gnyid chang rmongs pas phyin chad ma bskangs pa// bzod par gsol lo tshangs par bstsal du gsol// dam tshig lhag ma kha chu'i 'od zer 'phro// kun tu bzang po'i mchod sprin a mṛta// sha khrag bdud rtsi'i mchod pa chen po 'dis// las kyi mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskang gyur cig /oṃ/ stong khams yongs su 'chol bar gyur mod kyang*// bdag ni rdo rje'i dam las mi 'da' zhing*// dpal chen sgom sgrub las la brtson lags na// skyes chen khyed kyi thugs dam mnyes gyur cig /dur khrod klong dgu'i mkha' 'gro rnam bzhi'i tshogs/ khams gsum 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal ci 'dra ba// byams mgon khyed kyi thugs la de ltar mnga'// dmyal tshogs me ltar 'bar ba zhi bar mdzod// thugs rje'i gdung 'tshob rig 'dzin bdag gis ni// dang por byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed nas// 'da' ka rdo rje dam tshig mchog gsum po// rgyal ba'i bka' las 'da' bar mi bgyid pa// gsang sngags 'chol bar gyur pas bsal dka' mod// nyams dang tshogs 'dres nyams gyur bskangs so 'tshal// blo sems brtul bas skyon can ma rtogs te// rang gnong 'gyod pa'i sems kyis mthol bshags na// grogs ngan nyams grib skyon gyis ma gos shing*// nyams pa rnams la chad pa sgor bcad de// tshe 'di'i rkyen dang yun sgrib mi 'gyur bar// phra men sprul tshogs khyed kyis dbye bsal mdzad du gsol//
